sloka: असौ तु सागरो भीमः सेतुकर्मदिदृक्षया ।ददौ दण्डभयाद्गाधम् राघवाय महोदधिः ॥६-२२-४८॥।।
transliteration: asau tu sāgaro bhīmaḥ setukarmadidṛkṣayā ।dadau daṇḍabhayādgādham rāghavāya mahodadhiḥ ॥6-22-48॥।।

translations.english: This fearsome ocean of mighty Sagara (dug by Sagara) then allowed a passage for Rama, out of fear of punishment and also to witness the building of a bridge.
